A Support button in the corner, and update checks that are always on.

**Windows:** `Deviload-2.6.1-setup.exe`, or accept the update prompt in the app.

**Mac (test build):** accept the update prompt, or take `Deviload-2.6.1-macos-test.zip`, move it to Applications and run `xattr -cr /Applications/Deviload.app` once.

**Linux (x86_64):** `Deviload-2.6.1-amd64.deb` or `Deviload-2.6.1-x86_64.AppImage`; the AppImage updates itself.

What's new

- A quiet Support button in the bottom right corner opens Deviload's Ko-fi page; messages now rise above it
- Deviload always looks for a new version at start and every 6 hours; only the version number is requested
- "Later" on the update notice now hides it until the next check, six hours on, instead of three days

Full changelog: https://github.com/Pronexsteam/deviload/compare/v2.6.0...v2.6.1
